# BlogNlPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `BlogNlElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## Header

- **`Nederlands (NL)`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogNlElements` as `NEDERLANDS_NL_BUTTON`: `click().nederlandsNl()`.
- **`Aanmelden`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogNlElements` as `AANMELDEN_BUTTON`: `click().aanmelden()`.
- **`Tarieven`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogNlElements` as `TARIEVEN_BUTTON`: `click().tarieven()`.
- **`Probeer het gratis uit`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogNlElements` as `PROBEER_HET_GRATIS_UIT_BUTTON`: `click().probeerHetGratisUit()`.

## In the page

- **`Abonneer je op de blog`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogNlElements` as `ABONNEER_JE_OP_DE_BLOG_BUTTON`: `click().abonneerJeOpDeBlog()`.
